G1_unambiguity.justification: The direction and endpoint conditions unambiguously characterize when every tube must run from a mode-1 lens to a mode-2 lens.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies all relevant bounds, input and output formats, flow behavior including self-loops, and the lexicographic tie-break rule.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The flow condition is equivalent to requiring every tube to connect lenses with different modes, including making self-loops impossible, so it asks for exactly the original bipartite assignment.

G4_naturalness.justification: The themed optical-instrument framing is coherent and readable, though it is more elaborate and contrived than necessary for the underlying graph-coloring task.
